name: floating-action-button
title: Floating action button
description: The round primary action pinned to a corner: it extends to show its label, shrinks to the icon on scroll, and clears the bottom bar and safe area.
docs: It is fixed to the viewport; pass className="absolute" to pin it inside a positioned container. Give scrollTarget the ref of the element that scrolls when the page does not. offset lifts it over a bottom navigation, and visible hides it while a dialog is open. With href, disabled dims the link, takes it out of the tab order and stops the navigation.
